newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bond futures surge with Bunds after US CPI.
newsitem.headline: French bond futures surge with Bunds after US CPI.

text.p: 1430 GMT - June bond future posts solid gains as bonds reacted positively to US March CPI. Traders said French futures also pulled higher by US funds pushing Bunds towards 100.80 target. PIBOR contracts also up, strong dollar keeping franc near 3.36 per mark. Some 2-, 5-yr selling seen ahead of auction.
*5.50 2007 OAT yield 5.70 pct vs 5.80. Bund spread -14 vs -13
*Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Jun PIBOR 96.69, up 3 bp
